title: Put every search behind one interface
milestone: M2.5
labels:
  - kind: refactor
  - area: evolution
parent: m2.5-p4-one-search-framework
---

`IGeneticAlgorithm` is a generation-step interface over `Individual` and `Network`, while `ProgramSearch`, `ShrinkRun`, the `PartEvolution` shrink, composition search and the stagnation decorators each run their own loop; there are two algorithm catalogs joined by name strings, and `AlgorithmCatalog.IsComposition` decides by name prefix.
We want `ISearch<TCandidate>`: run against a task or contract, a budget, seeds and an optional stall policy, returning `SearchOutcome`; every existing search implements it, the shared parts are written once, and one catalog registers searches by type.

Its responsibilities are:
* The interface, with the genetic algorithms behind it through one adapter over `IGeneticAlgorithm`
* `ShrinkRun` and the `PartEvolution` shrink merged into one shrink search (MAP-Elites over `HardwareCost`, verified), keeping the "take the smallest solvers and verify" step once
* A `StallDetector` used by `StagnationRecovery`, `ModularEvolution`, `PartProposals` and `ProgramSearch`
* `Immigrate`, the fitness history line and "put module copies into the best networks" written once
* `ProgramSearch` using the shared lexicase, ranking, restart and confirmation, and split into search, edits and scoring
* One catalog, in the search layer, with the CLI's `Catalog` reading it; composition decided by type

A search should not need to know which other searches exist, because SMT, rewrite and enumerative searches will be added by registering one class each.
The merged shrink should give the same networks as the `PartEvolution` shrink on the golden runs, because parts in `parts/` were shrunk by it; differences from `ShrinkRun`'s results on `compile` should be listed.

Where: `SNP_Evolution/Evolution/IGeneticAlgorithm.cs`, `GeneticAlgorithm.cs`, `SpeciatedAlgorithm.cs`, `MuPlusLambdaStrategy.cs`, `MapElites.cs`, `StagnationRecovery.cs`, `IterativeEvolution.cs`, `EvolutionContext.cs`, `SNP_Evolution/Evolution/Modules/ModularEvolution.cs`, `CompositionSearch.cs`, `SNP_Evolution/Evolution/Proposals/PartProposals.cs`, `SNP_Evolution/Compilation/ProgramSearch.cs`, `ShrinkRun.cs`, `SNP_Evolution/Evolution/Contracts/PartEvolution.cs`, `SNP_Evolution/Cli/Catalog.cs`.

Done when:
- [ ] Every search implements `ISearch` and is listed by one catalog; no code matches algorithms by name string except the CLI's lookup
- [ ] Stall detection, immigration and solve confirmation each have one definition
- [ ] A test adds a trivial search by registering one class and runs it from `benchmark`
- [ ] Golden runs unchanged, or each change explained; `dotnet test` green

Read first: README "Algorithms", "Checks, lexicase selection and modules", "Compile, then shrink"
